description: Implement Phase 1 of the speaker recognition feature per the consensus-approved plan at .omc/plans/speaker-recognition.md. Phase 1 ships the complete security fix: on-device ECAPA-TDNN speaker embedding + owner-only gallery + decider confirmation gating + storage migration + conditional prompt gating + stranger integration test. Phase 2 (auto-enrollment, CLI management, drift audit) is explicitly out of scope.
scope_note: Feature is OFF by default via settings.speaker_id_enabled=False. speechbrain + torch live behind [project.optional-dependencies].speaker. speechbrain imports are lazy (deferred inside speaker_id.load_model). All tests mock speaker_id.embed at the module boundary — no model download in CI. Existing 226 tests must still pass byte-identically with flag off (golden-string regression test enforces this).

stories.title: speaker_id.py + speaker_gallery.py modules (ECAPA wrapper + owner-only gallery with sanitize_label)
stories.evidence: src/speaker_id.py: module-level imports limited to logging/numpy/typing (no speechbrain/torch). load_model() lazy-imports EncoderClassifier, caches _model global. warmup() generates 1s white-noise int16 PCM, runs embed(), logs elapsed. embed() converts int16 PCM → float32 tensor (normalized /32768), model.encode_batch, L2-normalize. cosine() with 1e-12 epsilon. src/speaker_gallery.py: LABEL_MAX_LEN=32, LABEL_FORBIDDEN=re.compile(r'[{}<>\n\r\t\x00-\x1f]'), LabelValidationError(ValueError), sanitize_label(). SpeakerGallery: path, _speakers dict, asyncio.Lock (reserved for Phase 2), load() handles missing+malformed, save() uses os.replace atomic write with temp cleanup on failure, identify() (owner-only in Phase 1), enroll_owner() sanitizes label, get_centroid() L2-normalized mean. tests/test_speaker_id.py (7 tests) mocks speechbrain via sys.modules monkeypatch — FakeClassifier + FakeTensor + FakeNoGrad, no torch needed. tests/test_speaker_gallery.py (20 tests): parametric sanitize accept/reject (8+4 cases), empty/missing/malformed load, enroll+identify, mismatch, roundtrip, atomic-save-on-failure (mid-write OSError via patch), get_centroid missing+averaging. 262 passed, ruff clean.
stories.rationale: Core compute + persistence layer. speaker_id wraps SpeechBrain ECAPA with lazy imports and white-noise warmup. speaker_gallery implements atomic persistence, owner-only identification for Phase 1, and sanitize_label to harden against prompt injection via rename CLI (Phase 2). All torch imports must be deferred so disabled installs don't pay the cost.
acceptanceCriteria: src/speaker_id.py exists with module-level imports limited to: `from __future__ import annotations`, `import logging`, `import numpy as np`, `from typing import Any` — NO speechbrain, NO torch at module level

src/speaker_id.py defines `load_model() -> Any` that performs lazy `from speechbrain.inference.speaker import EncoderClassifier; return EncoderClassifier.from_hparams(source='speechbrain/spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb', savedir='~/.heare/speaker_model', run_opts={'device':'cpu'})` and caches the result in a module-level `_model` variable so subsequent calls are no-ops

src/speaker_id.py defines `warmup(model: Any, sample_rate: int = 16000) -> None` that generates a 1-second white-noise int16 PCM buffer via `np.random.randint(-1000, 1000, sample_rate, dtype=np.int16)` and passes it through embed() to force JIT compilation — log `[SPEAKER] warmup complete (%.0fms)` at INFO level

src/speaker_id.py defines `embed(pcm: bytes, sample_rate: int, model: Any) -> np.ndarray` that converts pcm int16 bytes to float32 tensor normalized to [-1,1], calls model.encode_batch, returns a 1-D numpy array (L2-normalized, dtype=float32)
src/speaker_id.py defines `cosine(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float` computing `float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b) + 1e-12))`

src/speaker_gallery.py exists with: `LABEL_MAX_LEN = 32`, `LABEL_FORBIDDEN = re.compile(r"[{}<>\n\r\t\x00-\x1f]")`, `class LabelValidationError(ValueError)`, `def sanitize_label(raw: str) -> str` which strips whitespace, raises LabelValidationError if empty, if longer than LABEL_MAX_LEN, or if LABEL_FORBIDDEN matches — returns cleaned string otherwise

src/speaker_gallery.py defines `class SpeakerGallery` with fields: `path: Path`, `_speakers: dict[str, dict]`, `_lock: asyncio.Lock` (declared but unused in Phase 1 — comment: 'Phase 1: single-writer from pipeline; lock reserved for Phase 2 auto-enroll/drift-audit concurrency')
SpeakerGallery.load(path: Path) -> SpeakerGallery: reads path if exists, parses JSON, returns populated gallery; on missing file or parse error, returns empty gallery (logs WARNING on parse error)
SpeakerGallery.save() -> None: writes self._speakers as JSON to a temp file in the same directory, then os.replace to self.path (atomic write). On write failure, does not clobber existing file

SpeakerGallery.identify(v: np.ndarray) -> tuple[str | None, float]: iterates self._speakers items, returns (speaker_id, max_cosine) if max ≥ threshold_match, else (None, max_cosine). Empty gallery returns (None, 0.0)

SpeakerGallery.enroll_owner(v: np.ndarray, label: str = 'owner') -> None: sanitizes label, creates/replaces _speakers['owner'] = {'label': label, 'embeddings': [v.tolist()], 'created_at': iso8601_now, 'updated_at': iso8601_now, 'turn_count': 1}, calls save()
SpeakerGallery.get_centroid(speaker_id: str) -> np.ndarray | None: averages the embeddings list, L2-normalizes; returns None if speaker not in gallery

stories.title: speaker_processor.py — AudioBufferProcessor + SpeakerTaggerProcessor with per-turn _TurnSlot, fire-and-forget embed, finalized filter, bot-speaking gate
stories.evidence: src/speaker_processor.py: @dataclass _TurnSlot with task + event + pcm + embedding + error + elapsed_ms + duration_ms. AudioBufferProcessor: lazy pipecat import via _build_processor_classes, on UserStartedSpeakingFrame allocates new slot, on AudioRawFrame asserts 16kHz and appends audio, on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame joins chunks and fires loop.create_task(_run_embed). _gc_old_slots keeps _SLOT_RETAIN=4 most recent and cancels evicted in-flight tasks. close() cancels all pending with 1s bounded gather. SpeakerTaggerProcessor: owns _bot_speaking flag, subscribes to Bot*SpeakingFrame. On InterimTranscriptionFrame: push through. On TranscriptionFrame: `if not getattr(frame, 'finalized', True): push and return`; if bot speaking: attach None+-1.0 and return; else await slot.event with 200ms timeout → fail-closed on timeout/embed-error; short-turn (<400ms) inherits prev_id; else identify via gallery with threshold. Logs speaker_id only (never speaker_label). create_speaker_processors factory wires both. tests/test_speaker_processor.py: 12 tests — capture PCM, sample-rate assertion raises, ignore interim, ignore finalized=False, skip during bot speaking, fail-closed on slot timeout within 300ms, match owner via mocked embed, stranger returns None, short-turn inherits, gc cancels in-flight, shutdown cancels within 1.2s, build_processor_classes idempotent cache. 279 passed total, ruff clean. Verified pipecat TranscriptionFrame.finalized defaults to False (confirmed via pipecat source) so tests must explicitly set finalized=True.
stories.rationale: The hardest file: correctly handles the pipecat frame race, fire-and-forget parallelism with STT, asyncio.Event handoff, slot GC and task cancellation on shutdown, finalized filter for interim transcriptions, sample-rate assertion, and bot-speaking gate. Tests mock speaker_id.embed at module boundary to avoid torch.
acceptanceCriteria: src/speaker_processor.py exists with lazy pipecat imports (deferred inside _build_processor_classes, mirror of decider.py pattern)

src/speaker_processor.py defines @dataclass class _TurnSlot with fields: turn_id: int, pcm: bytes | None = None, embedding: np.ndarray | None = None, error: Exception | None = None, elapsed_ms: float = 0.0, event: asyncio.Event = field(default_factory=asyncio.Event), task: asyncio.Task | None = None, inherited: bool = False

AudioBufferProcessor: subclass of pipecat FrameProcessor. On UserStartedSpeakingFrame: allocates new _TurnSlot with monotonically increasing turn_id, stores in self._slots dict, sets self._current_turn, clears self._chunks buffer. On AudioRawFrame: asserts frame.sample_rate == 16000, appends frame.audio to self._chunks. On UserStoppedSpeakingFrame: joins self._chunks into slot.pcm, kicks off slot.task = loop.create_task(self._run_embed(slot)). _run_embed calls loop.run_in_executor(None, speaker_id.embed, slot.pcm, 16000, self._model), stores result in slot.embedding or slot.error, measures elapsed_ms, sets slot.event. AudioBufferProcessor._gc_old_slots: keeps at most 4 slots, on eviction calls slot.task.cancel() if not done. AudioBufferProcessor.close(): cancels all pending slot.tasks, awaits via asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True) with 1-second timeout

SpeakerTaggerProcessor: subclass of pipecat FrameProcessor. Owns self._bot_speaking flag. On BotStartedSpeakingFrame: sets _bot_speaking=True. On BotStoppedSpeakingFrame: schedules cooldown via asyncio.Task that clears flag after bot_speaking_cooldown_seconds. On TranscriptionFrame: FIRST checks `if not getattr(frame, 'finalized', True): push and return` (ignore interim transcriptions from Groq); SECOND checks `if self._bot_speaking: attach speaker_id=None, confidence=-1.0, push and return`; THIRD resolves the latest slot via `self.buffer.latest_completed_turn_id()`, awaits slot.event with 200ms timeout, if timeout or error: attach speaker_id=None confidence=0.0 and push (fail-closed fallback)

SpeakerTaggerProcessor: on successful embed result, checks duration threshold (voiced frames < 400ms → inherit prev label, confidence=-1.0, inherited=True), otherwise calls gallery.identify(slot.embedding) → attaches speaker_id, speaker_confidence, speaker_label, speaker_inherited, speaker_turn_id on the frame (mutates attributes — TranscriptionFrame is a plain @dataclass, not frozen, verified in plan §4)
SpeakerTaggerProcessor logs `[SPEAKER] turn_id=%d sid=%s conf=%.2f inherited=%s elapsed_ms=%.0f` at INFO level on every tagged turn (log speaker_id only, NEVER speaker_label — privacy)

src/speaker_processor.py factory function `create_speaker_processors(settings, gallery) -> tuple[AudioBufferProcessor, SpeakerTaggerProcessor]` constructs both processors with mutual reference (tagger holds weakref to buffer for slot lookup)

tests/test_speaker_processor.py test_tagger_skips_during_bot_speaking: dispatches BotStartedSpeakingFrame then TranscriptionFrame, asserts speaker_id=None, confidence=-1.0 and embed NOT called

stories.title: Stranger integration test + full regression verification
stories.evidence: tests/test_stranger_integration.py: 3 end-to-end scenarios wiring AudioBufferProcessor → SpeakerTaggerProcessor → DeciderProcessor with mocked speaker_id.embed via rig fixture. Test 1 (stranger_in_listening): stranger vector (orthogonal to owner) → tagger returns speaker_id=None → decider drops via non-owner filter → no decider call, no state change, transcript persisted. Test 2 (stranger_interrupts_confirmation): owner arms AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, stranger says 'так' (long enough not to inherit) → decider rejects via speaker mismatch → call_action never awaited → state stays AWAITING_CONFIRMATION. Test 3 (short_turn_in_confirmation): owner arms, short 300ms 'так' inherits owner label → decider rejects on speaker_inherited=True → call_action never awaited → state stays AWAITING_CONFIRMATION. Test helper _run_turn_through_pipeline waits for a NEW completed turn_id (not just non-None) to avoid race across sequential turns. 292 passed, ruff clean. Test count evolution: 226 baseline → 232 (SPK-001) → 262 (SPK-002) → 267 (SPK-003) → 279 (SPK-004) → 289 (SPK-005) → 292 (SPK-006). Flag-off path verified by golden-string test (SPK-003) which confirms prompts/decider.txt renders with NO 'Speaker: owner' line when flag is off.
stories.rationale: Scripted end-to-end test proves the security gate: synthetic stranger audio through a mocked pipeline must not trigger EXECUTING. Also runs full pytest + ruff to confirm zero regressions with flag on AND flag off.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_stranger_integration.py exists with three scenarios using a mocked pipeline (AudioBufferProcessor + SpeakerTaggerProcessor + DeciderProcessor composed with in-memory store and mocked claude_cli)

test_stranger_integration.py scenario 1 — stranger_in_listening: gallery has only 'owner', mocked embed returns a vector with cos<0.55 to owner → speaker_id=None → decider drops with non-owner filter → assert decider.state == LISTENING throughout, assert no EXECUTING transition, assert no TTS frame pushed, assert store.log_transcript has speaker_id=None

test_stranger_integration.py scenario 2 — stranger_interrupts_confirmation: arm AWAITING_CONFIRMATION via an owner turn, then inject a stranger 'так' turn (mocked embed returns non-owner vector) → assert decider stays in AWAITING_CONFIRMATION (does NOT execute), assert TTSSpeakFrame('Скажи: так чи ні?') pushed

test_stranger_integration.py scenario 3 — short_turn_in_confirmation: arm AWAITING_CONFIRMATION via an owner turn, then inject a 300ms short turn (voiced duration < 400ms, tagger inherits prev label with speaker_inherited=True) → assert decider does NOT execute, asserts inheritance was refused
uv run pytest tests/ -q with speaker_id_enabled=False → all existing 226 tests still pass byte-identically (golden-string test confirms prompt invariance)
uv run pytest tests/ -q with speaker_id_enabled=True env override → all tests pass including new ones
uv run ruff check src/ tests/ → All checks passed
grep for the string 'speaker_label' in daemon.log mock output confirms human label never appears (only speaker_id='owner'/'unknown')
.omc/progress.txt section 'SPK-006' documents the test count evolution and any new learnings
